snippet.title: code_report
snippet.description:
Welcome to code_report! A competitive programming YouTube channel.

Every Sunday I post a weekly episode where I review the competitive programming contests that happened over the last week from HackerRank, CodeChef, LeetCode, HackerEarth, topcoder and Codeforces. Throughout the rest of the week, I will post other videos on solutions, algorithms, data structures and more! Subscribe and lets climb the leaderboards together!

Disclaimer: I do not work for any of these companies / websites. I am just doing this for fun :)
